name: Fast Reset on Death
description: On death, instantly restarts the level from its start - even if you've already claimed a midway ring - skipping the death-fade animation and the "try again" retry screen. The level-name intro card is hidden on these fast-restarts (but still shown on a normal first entry from the map). Faithful to the Flutter hack, which always sends you back to the top of the level ("as if just entered"): you keep your life (a free retry), only the long death/retry sequence is cut. Game over still happens normally when you genuinely run out of lives elsewhere.
attribution: Faithful recreation of the Flutter hack's death-reroute (https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/8972/)
details: asm-patch port of Flutter's two in-place death edits + custom dispatcher (vanilla<->Flutter byte diff traced in yi-shiny/trace-harness/scenarios/fast-reset). Hooks the death bookkeeping routine CODE_04F6E2 at its death-music write ($04:F6EB) with a JML to FastReset_OnDeath, and NOPs the gamemode store in the shared death set CODE_04F6CE ($04:F6D1) so the reroute's gamemode sticks through the fall-through. FastReset_OnDeath (%patchcode, reserved $51 pool slice) queues SFX $22, branches on midway-ring-touched $03AC: ring -> zeroes CheckpointReentryPage $03BE, forces the retry selector $704094 to 0 (continue), and sets gamemode $35 (load_restart_from_midring). Vanilla gm35 rebuilds the entrance from CurrentLevelFromMap $021A + $03BE; with $03BE=0 that resolves to the level-START entrance (page 0), NOT the checkpoint - so a midring death restarts at the top of the level, matching Flutter (Flutter achieves the same with its own level-ID stash + a rewritten gm35 entrance builder + a $C181 staging helper; we get the identical destination through the stock gm35 builder by forcing the checkpoint page to 0, while still routing through gm35 so its continue-path state cleanup runs). no ring -> gamemode $0B (fade -> gm0C reload from level start, $038C=0). Then SFX $17, increments the Flutter death counter $026A (unused by yi-shiny), and JMLs to $04:F6FC - PAST the DEC CurrentLifeCount at $04:F6F9 - so NO life is lost (the death-in-level counter still increments). The gm35 retry prompt is auto-confirmed: $01:E5FF redirects the no-button JMP from the wait-state ($01:E687) to the confirmed path ($01:E601), and $01:E689 NOPs the retry text box, so the midring restart is instant. This is the only fast-reset variant (replaces the former level-start-only and midring-only binary patches); it reproduces Flutter's full behavior in one patch. Because the $04:F6EB hijack runs before the death-music write ($04:F6EE STA $004D never executes), the level music carries through death automatically. CONDITIONAL LEVEL-NAME SUPPRESS (added): the SuperFX level-name render dispatch at $00:C7A8 (vanilla 'JSL $7EDE44') is redirected to SuppressName_IfReset, which PHA-preserves A then reads $026A - if nonzero (a fast-reset) it skips the render, else it runs the original JSL $7EDE44 - so the name card is hidden on fast-restarts but shown on a fresh map entry. $026A is cleared on overworld entry (gm20 prepare, $17:A5AE - displacing 'LDA #$03 : STA $094B', replayed in ClearResetCounter, leftover byte NOP'd) so the next fresh level shows its name. Mirrors Flutter's $A1:C125 / $A1:C133. All stubs are bump-allocated into the reserved $51 patch-pool slice via %patchcode (not asar freecode). This conditional level-name suppress is built into the fast-reset (there is no separate level-name-suppress patch). WIPE-IN WAIT SKIP (added): gm0c's fresh-load path busy-waits at CODE_01B1C8 ('LDA $0D23 : CMP #$00C0 : BCC -8') for the wipe window to ramp to $C0 - ~210 frames (~3.5s) of black before the iris starts, which is most of the normal intro time. CODE_01B1C8 is hijacked to SkipWipeWait_IfReset, which checks $026A and, on a fast-reset, jumps straight past the wait to $01:B1D0 (a fresh map entry still waits normally). This mirrors Flutter's $A1:C0E8 and is what makes the reload feel instant; without it the death reroute is correct but the wipe still appears ~3s late. MUSIC CARRY-THROUGH (added): gm0c's fresh-load path re-issues the level-music command (LDA #$03 : STA PlayMusic at $01:B1AA), but on a fast-reset the reload's upload_music_data early-returns (block mirror $0203 unchanged) so it never re-uploads the song to the SPC - and PlayMusic=$03 alone can't restart a stopped song, leaving it silent ('short riff then silence', traced: Flutter issues NO PlayMusic on a reset, we issued $03). CODE_01B149+$61 ($01:B1AA) is hijacked to ConditionalLevelMusic, which gates the write on $026A (skip on a reset so the still-playing song carries through, replay on a fresh entry) - exactly Flutter's $A1:C177. The midring branch needs in-game verification.
asm: ; --- patch-private RAM scratch ---
!FastReset_Counter = $026A                   ; free in stock YI (no engine reader/writer); persists across the fast-reset reload. RAM defines are in scope in the FinalizeROM phase.
; --- Flutter fast-reset: in-place edits on the shared death path ---
org !CODE_04F6CE+$03 : db $EA,$EA,$EA          ; NOP CODE_04F6CE's 'STA $0118' so the reroute's gamemode survives the fall-through
org !CODE_04F6E2+$09 : JML FastReset_OnDeath   ; hijack CODE_04F6E2 at the death-music write (before the life DEC at $04F6F9)
; --- gm35 (load_restart_from_midring): auto-confirm the retry prompt for an instant midring restart ---
org !CODE_gm35_load_restart_from_midring+$16 : db $01                  ; redirect the no-button-press JMP from the wait-state ($01E687) to the confirmed path ($01E601)
org !CODE_retry_screen_per_frame : db $EA,$EA,$EA          ; NOP the retry-screen 'JSR CODE_show_message_box' so no prompt box flashes
; --- conditional Suppress Level-Name Intro: hide the name card only on a fast-reset ---
org !CODE_render_stage_intro_level_name+$30 : JSL SuppressName_IfReset   ; redirect the SuperFX level-name render dispatch (vanilla 'JSL $7EDE44') to the conditional stub
org !CODE_gm20_prepare_overworld+$20 : JSL ClearResetCounter : db $EA ; gm20 overworld-prep: clear $026A on map entry (was 'LDA #$03 : STA $094B'; NOP the leftover 5th byte)
; --- skip the level-load 'wipe-in' busy-wait on a fast-reset (THE one that made resets ~3s) ---
; gm0c's fresh-load path spins at CODE_01B1C8 ('LDA $0D23 : CMP #$00C0 : BCC -8') until the
; wipe window ramps to $C0 - ~210 frames of black before the iris even starts. Flutter skips it
; on a reset (its $A1:C0E8 checks $026A first); we do the same. Without this the death reroute
; works but the reload still waits the full intro, so the wipe appears ~3s late instead of <1s.
org !CODE_01B1C8 : JML SkipWipeWait_IfReset           ; replaces the 'LDA $0D23' wait-loop head; stub returns to CODE_01B1C8+$08 ($01:B1D0)
; --- skip the level-load music re-trigger on a fast-reset (THE 'riff then silence' fix) ---
; gm0c's fresh-load path re-issues the level-music command ('LDA #$03 : STA PlayMusic' at $01:B1AA).
; On a fast-reset the reload's upload_music_data EARLY-RETURNS (block mirror $0203 still matches), so
; it never re-uploads the song to the SPC - and PlayMusic=$03 alone can't restart a stopped song ->
; the level music goes silent. Flutter gates this exact write on $026A ($A1:C177: 'LDA $026A : BNE +4
; : LDA #$03 : STA $4D'): fresh entry plays it, a reset skips it so the still-playing song carries
; through untouched. We do the same. (Traced: Flutter issues NO PlayMusic on a reset; we issued $03.)
org !CODE_01B149+$61 : JSL ConditionalLevelMusic      ; $01:B1AA = the loader's 'LDA #$03 : STA PlayMusic' (4b); gate it on $026A
; --- custom death dispatcher (%patchcode: reserved $51 pool slice) ---
%patchcode()
FastReset_OnDeath:
PHP
LDA.w #$0022 : JSL !CODE_push_sound_queue   ; SFX $22 (death whoosh, per Flutter)
LDA.w !RAM_YI_Level_MiddleRingsTouchedLo   ; did the player claim a midway ring?
BEQ .levelStart
STZ.w !RAM_YI_Level_CheckpointReentryPageLo ; FLUTTER PARITY: zero the checkpoint page so gm35 rebuilds the level-START
;   entrance (CurrentLevelFromMap $021A + page 0), NOT the midway checkpoint.
;   Flutter restarts at the top of the level even after a ring is claimed; vanilla
;   gm35 would index its entrance table by $03BE (the checkpoint page), so forcing
;   $03BE=0 sends it to page 0 = 'as if just entered'. We still route via gm35 (not
;   gm0B) so the continue-path state cleanup runs; only the destination is overridden.
SEP.b #$20                           ; force the retry selector to 'continue'
LDA.b #$00 : STA.l $704094           ;   so gm35's TXA/BNE takes the restore path (selector has no literal writer)
REP.b #$20
LDA.w #$0035                          ; gamemode $35 = load_restart_from_midring (entrance now resolves to the start)
BRA .setMode
.levelStart:
LDA.w #$000B                          ; gamemode $0B = fade -> gm0C reload from level start ($038C stays 0)
.setMode:
STA.w !RAM_YI_Global_CurrentGameMode  ; the org-NOP at $04F6D1 keeps this from being clobbered
LDA.w #$0017 : JSL !CODE_push_sound_queue   ; SFX $17 (restart sting, per Flutter)
INC.w !FastReset_Counter              ; mark this reload so SuppressName_IfReset hides the level-name card
PLP
JML !CODE_04F6F1+$0B                   ; resume PAST 'DEC CurrentLifeCount' -> free retry, no life lost
%endpatchcode()
; --- conditional level-name suppress stubs (%patchcode: reserved $51 pool slice) ---
%patchcode()
SuppressName_IfReset:
PHA                                   ; preserve A (= FXCODE_09E92F entry offset for the render call)
LDA.w !FastReset_Counter              ; set by FastReset_OnDeath, cleared on overworld entry
BNE .skip                             ;   nonzero -> this load is a fast-reset: skip the level-name card
PLA
JSL $7EDE44                           ;   zero -> fresh entry: run the normal SuperFX level-name render
RTL
.skip:
PLA                                   ; balance the stack; render skipped
RTL
%endpatchcode()
%patchcode()
ClearResetCounter:
STZ.w !FastReset_Counter              ; overworld entry: clear the counter so the next level shows its name
LDA.b #$03 : STA.w !RAM_YI_Global_OAMSizeAndDataAreaDesignation ; replay the displaced gm20 instruction (8-bit A here)
RTL
%endpatchcode()
; --- wipe-in wait skip (%patchcode): mirrors Flutter's $A1:C0E8 ---
; On a fast-reset, skip gm0c's busy-wait for the wipe window; on a fresh map entry,
; run the stock wait so the intro times normally. M=16 here (gm0c did REP #$20).
%patchcode()
SkipWipeWait_IfReset:
LDA.w !FastReset_Counter              ; $026A: nonzero => this load is a fast-reset
BNE .skip                            ;   -> skip the wipe-in wait (instant reload)
.wait:
LDA.w !RAM_YI_Level_StageClearWipeTopYLo ; stock path: wait until the wipe window opens to $C0
CMP.w #$00C0
BCC .wait
.skip:
JML !CODE_01B1C8+$08                  ; resume past the wait at $01:B1D0
%endpatchcode()
; --- conditional level-music re-trigger (%patchcode): mirrors Flutter's $A1:C177 ---
; Called in place of the loader's 'LDA #$03 : STA PlayMusic' ($01:B1AA). M=8 at the call site
; (the JSL'd-over instructions were 8-bit), so reads/writes are 8-bit here.
%patchcode()
ConditionalLevelMusic:
LDA.w !FastReset_Counter              ; $026A: nonzero => fast-reset
BNE .skip                            ;   -> DON'T re-issue the music command; the song carries through
LDA.b #$03                            ; fresh entry -> replay the loader's 'play level music' command
STA.b !RAM_YI_Global_PlayMusicLo     ;   (PlayMusic = $03, the original write this JSL replaced)
.skip:
RTL
%endpatchcode()
